title: 国际燃气联盟：中国如何影响全球天然气市场？
speaker: Mel Eidros

segments.en: Well, China currently consumes just over 10% of the world's gas consumption.
segments.zh: 目前，中国天然气消费量占全球略超10%。

segments.en: But they have diversified sources of supply, whether it's pipeline, gas, L&G, and domestic
segments.zh: 但供应来源多元，包括管道气、液化天然气和国内

segments.en: And those are areas that they continue to focus on, particularly storage, but storage becomes
segments.zh: 这些是他们持续关注的领域，尤其是储存，但储存

segments.en: very important as a peak-shaving asset.
segments.zh: 作为调峰资产变得非常重要。

segments.en: Storage on the gas industry is not like strategic reserves on the oil.
segments.zh: 天然气行业的储存不同于石油的战略储备。

segments.en: They operate much differently. It is a peak-shaving asset as opposed to an asset that sits there and only gets called
segments.zh: 它们运作方式大不相同。它是调峰资产，而不是那种闲置在那里、只在
极端情况下才被调用的资产。

segments.en: So the early decision by the Chinese government to stop the exports of fertilizers, gasoline,
segments.zh: 因此，中国政府早期决定停止出口化肥、汽油、

segments.en: jet fuel, of course, looked after the domestic market, and leverage on the export of the L&G
segments.zh: 航空燃油等，当然是为了照顾国内市场，并利用液化天然气出口的杠杆

segments.en: cargoes that were intended to come to China.
segments.zh: 原本要运往中国的货物。

segments.en: Again, it depends on how the economy develops and the need for gas, so we'll see how that
segments.zh: 这取决于经济发展和天然气需求，所以我们看看情况如何

segments.en: plays out. But it is a very important player in the global gas industry.
segments.zh: 演变。但中国在全球天然气行业中是非常重要的参与者。
